# dsh-free-image
Keyless image generation for DeepSeek Harness.

`dsh-free-image` gives your DSH agent a `generate_image` tool that needs **no API
key and no paid ac

count**. A provider is just an HTTP GET endpoint that returns
image bytes for a prompt, so the plugi

n works out of the box against a free
public endpoint and can be pointed at a self-hosted one by cha

f the box against a free
public endpoint and can be pointed at a self-hosted one by changing config.

Free endpoints are rate limited per IP. The plugin therefore runs one call at a
time, honours the en

dpoint's "retry after N s" answer within a bounded budget,
and tells you the remaining wait instead

er N s" answer within a bounded budget,
and tells you the remaining wait instead of failing blindly.
## Tools
| Tool | Kind | What it does |
| `generate_image` | writes one file | Generates one image from a prompt, saves it under the configu

red directory, returns the absolute path, real pixel size and byte size. |
| `list_image_models` | r
ead-only | Lists the configured providers: endpoint, model, size limits, pacing, timeout, output dir
| Lists the configured providers: endpoint, model, size limits, pacing, timeout, output directory. |
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- No key is stored or sent; the request carries only the prompt and size.
- The response is validate

d as `image/*` before anything is written.
- Images larger than `output.maxBytes` are refused, not w

ritten.
- A `402`/`429`/`503` answer is retried after the wait it asks for, as long as
the wait fits
in `retry.budgetMs`; otherwise the tool reports the wait.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

No configuration is required: the default provider is the keyless public
endpoint. To change the end
point, size limits or output directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Configuration
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `providers[].id` | — | Provider id used by the tools. |
| `providers[].baseUrl` | `https://image.p
ollinations.ai/prompt` | Prompt endpoint; the encoded prompt is appended as the last path segment. |

| `providers[].model` | `''` | Optional `model` query parameter. |
| `providers[].maxWidth` / `maxH

eight` | `1024` | Largest size the tool may request from this provider. |
| `providers[].rateLimitMs

` | `45000` | Advertised pacing, reported to the model. |
| `providers[].timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per

-request HTTP timeout. |
| `defaults.provider` | first provider | Provider used when a call omits on

e. |
| `defaults.width` / `height` | `512` | Default image size. |
| `output.dir` | `<DSH_HOME>/gene

rated/images` | Where images are written. |
| `output.maxBytes` | `10485760` | Largest image the plu

gin will write. |
| `retry.budgetMs` | `90000` | How long one call may wait for a rate limit to clea

r. |
| `retry.maxAttempts` | `3` | Total HTTP attempts per call. |
## Self-hosted endpoints

The same plugin works against a local generation server that accepts a prompt in
the URL path and re

turns image bytes — for example an Automatic1111/ComfyUI front
end you put in front of it. Point `ba

seUrl` at it and the plugin needs no key
there either. This is the private alternative to a public f

ree endpoint: prompts
never leave your machine, and there is no 45-second pacing.
## Honest limits

- Public free endpoints are rate limited (about one image per 45 s per IP at the
time of writing), s

ometimes answer `503`, and may change their terms.
- Image quality is whatever the endpoint's defaul

t model produces.
- The prompt is sent to the endpoint; do not use a public endpoint for anything
pr

l produces.
- The prompt is sent to the endpoint; do not use a public endpoint for anything
private.
## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.4` (Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`).
- Outbound HTTPS to the configured endpoint.
